info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Operational Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Operational Service Retrieval API allows authorized users to fetch detailed information about specific operational services related to leasing item administration. By providing an identifier as 'param1', users can access relevant data for a designated service, facilitating efficient management and decision-making. This API is particularly useful for banking professionals who require real-time access to operational service details for reporting, compliance, or system integration purposes. Typical consumers include application developers, banking analysts, and operational managers.

get.description: Fetches detailed information about a specific leasing item identified by the given resource ID. This endpoint provides all relevant attributes associated with the leasing item, enabling clients to understand its specifications and status.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve specific information regarding leasing item administration for the service identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the required parameters and data formatting are strictly followed according to the schema provided.

200.description: The request was successful and the relevant data has been returned.
